scope: Static comparison of authored public documentation and generated MDX; browser rendering is verified separately.

visibilityDirectives.note: The excluded manual-installation branch is authored as unpublished content. Code payloads outside that branch remain unchanged.

htmlPreCode.method: Compare authored pre/code text to decoded generated JSON-string payloads, preserving newlines and literal pipes.

figures.note: Every current figure contains one image and an optional caption; the converter's first-image selection drops no additional figure content in this corpus.

htmlTables.note: List cells now retain visible bullet and line-break separators. Inline emphasis is unwrapped and adjacent text merged before table extraction, preserving endpoint underscores. Changed generated tables were reviewed for text and code preservation.

rawHtml.note: Literal placeholders inside code were excluded from HTML classification. Remaining unusual tags are escaped changelog placeholders or table selection metadata whose displayed labels remain.

limitations: These checks do not replace browser checks of media playback, layout, expandable sections, or heading scrolling.
They assess conversion fidelity and do not certify the accuracy of inherited documentation content.
